page_title: CHE 2-0 FUL | Chelsea v Fulham 30/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+9' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
90+9' Fulham take a short corner kick.
90+6' This is a yellow card! Sasa Lukic (Fulham) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+5' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) attempts to put in the resulting set piece, but he miskicks and sends the ball into the stands. A strong but inaccurate shot.
90+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Andrey Santos (Chelsea) was quite harsh and Robert Jones didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+2' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) meets an excellent cross and from the edge of the penalty box unleashes a fantastic header towards the bottom right corner of the goal, but it's blocked by a defender.
90+2' The referee blows his whistle, Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Adama Traore (Fulham).
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.

90' Reece James (Chelsea) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Bernd Leno!
87' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Raul Jimenez (Fulham), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles away of the left post. Poor effort.
86' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Bernd Leno easily deals with the threat.
84' Alex Iwobi will be replaced by Adama Traore (Fulham).
83' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alex Iwobi (Fulham), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
81' Substitution. Reece James (Chelsea) has come on for Pedro Neto.
81' Enzo Maresca has decided to make a change. Andrey Santos (Chelsea) replaces Tyrique George.
79' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Fulham, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
79' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Robert Jones saw the whole situation.
77' Kenny Tete (Fulham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
77' Fulham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
76' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Antonee Robinson (Fulham). The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Fulham.
73' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
71' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
71' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play. Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
70' A quickly taken corner by Chelsea.

70' Jamie Gittens (Chelsea) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Chelsea.
68' It is time for a substitution. Jamie Gittens (Chelsea) is on for Estêvão.
67' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Joshua King will be replaced by Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham).
67' Substitution. Antonee Robinson (Fulham) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ryan Sessegnon walks off.
66' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
65' It's a nice effort by Joao Pedro (Chelsea) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Bernd Leno. Easy save.
62' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) dribbles into the box, but Bernd Leno is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
60' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Harry Wilson (Fulham) replacing Timothy Castagne.
59' The manager makes a subsitution with Raul Jimenez (Fulham) coming on for Rodrigo Muniz.
59' Estêvão (Chelsea) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop.
56' 2 - 0 GOAL! Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) takes a real chance, but his penalty strike right into the middle of the net fools Bernd Leno in goal.
56' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
55' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!

51' Play continues despite the shouts by some Chelsea players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Robert Jones interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
51' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
51' Surely that's handball by one of the Fulham players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
51' Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
48' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! His effort goes miles wide of the left post. Poor header!
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+11' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+9' 1 - 0 Joao Pedro (Chelsea) manages to rise above the opponent's defenders to meet the well-taken corner kick with his head. His effort goes inside the right post. What a finish!
45+9' The ball goes out for a corner. Chelsea can continue in their attacking effort.

45+9' Tyrique George (Chelsea) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the bottom left corner. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Bernd Leno with a fabulous save.
45+8' Chelsea force their opponents to concede a corner.
45+8' Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
45+6' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

45+5' What a great touch by Joshua King (Fulham) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The referee signals a corner kick to Fulham.
45+2' The linesman signals that Estêvão (Chelsea) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
45' We will have 8 min. of added time.
45' Estêvão (Chelsea) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
43' What a miss! The corner finds Tosin Adarabioyo (Chelsea) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just over the bar.
42' Chelsea will take a corner kick.
42' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
40' The resulting free kick from Pedro Neto (Chelsea) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
39' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
38' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Jones had an easy-decision to make.
37' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
34' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) brings an opponent down and Robert Jones interrupts the game.
31' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
30' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Bernd Leno, who smothers the ball.
27' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

27' That didn't go as planned! Joshua King (Fulham) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Robert Sanchez, who easily kept it out.
25' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Fulham players look gutted.
23' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an infringement in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Fulham players aren’t happy.
21' Joshua King (Fulham) gets in a good position after an exceptional individual run and releases a powerful shot that flies precisely into the bottom left corner.
19' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
18' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
14' Enzo Maresca is forced to make a change. Liam Delap is unable to continue due to injury, Tyrique George (Chelsea) comes on.
14' Liam Delap (Chelsea) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
13' Liam Delap (Chelsea) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
13' Liam Delap (Chelsea) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
11' Estêvão (Chelsea) attempts to find Pedro Neto, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
10' Estêvão (Chelsea) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
7' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
6' Chelsea quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
6' Liam Delap (Chelsea) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
5' That didn't go as planned! Joao Pedro (Chelsea) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Bernd Leno, who easily kept it out.
3' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
2' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Chelsea will have the kick-off.
Robert Jones is the one to supervise the game today.
